# T4 checklist (task: the forecasting module, BRD in task/brd.md)

Task made up from webERP's forecasting module (commit ef95df0b3,
2026-03-19, 34 files +8,989), set at base 4cb937f79e8b (the tree's commit,
~500 app files before the module's real base). The BRD was written from the
module's manual (doc/Manual/ManualForecastManagement.html) in business
terms, without its file, table or SQL details.

**The reference is incomplete and was written on a later base.** Checked
2026-11-06 in the reference: (a) its sales history is
`salesorderdetails.quantity`, ordered and not invoiced, with no credits; (b)
it takes `debtorsmaster.salestype` as "customer type" (the customer type is
`debtorsmaster.typeid`); (c) it adds `custtype` and `loccode` columns to
`salesanalysis` but none of the pages that write `salesanalysis`
(ConfirmDispatch_Invoice.php, Credit_Invoice.php, CounterSales.php,
CounterReturns.php, ...) fills them; (d) it inserts the module at menu
position 7 without touching existing users' `www_users.modulesallowed`;
(e) its includes use the later `__DIR__` style. Grade against the BRD and
this checklist, not the reference.

A reviewer marks each item met / partly / missed.

1. Database for new and existing installs: an upgrade script
   `sql/updates/44.php` (the next number at the base) using webERP's
   helpers (`CreateTable`, `AddColumn`, `NewScript`, `NewMenuItem`,
   `NewModule`, `executeSQL`, `$_SESSION['Updates']['Errors']` gating), and
   the same objects in the fresh-install schema and data
   (`install/sql/tables/*.sql`, `install/sql/data/scripts.sql`,
   `menuitems.sql`, `modules.sql`).
2. Module access: the module appears in the main menu only for users allowed
   it, and WWW_Users.php can grant it (`$ModuleList`/`$ModuleListLabel`).
   Module visibility is the positional comma list
   `www_users.modulesallowed` read by `index.php` in the `modules`
   sequence order (`includes/LoginFunctions.php` explodes it), so a module
   inserted mid-list shifts every existing user's modules unless the
   upgrade rewrites their lists; `install`'s default admin list
   (`includes/InstallFunctions.php`) must match too. Met: existing users
   keep exactly their modules.
3. Page security and page structure: every new page is registered in
   `scripts` with a security level and appears in `menuitems` for the
   roles; pages follow webERP's page pattern (`includes/session.php`,
   `$Title`, header/footer, `FormID` on forms, `__()` strings, `prnMsg`),
   and do not escape POST data again (session.php already applies
   `DB_escape_string(htmlspecialchars())`).
4. Sales history is real sales: invoiced quantities net of credits (e.g.
   `stockmoves` types 10/11 with `-qty`, or `salesanalysis` actuals with
   `budgetoractual = 1` and its period mapping), in monthly buckets per
   item and location; re-extracting a range replaces it.
5. Summary forecasts by customer type, area and salesperson use the right
   fields (`debtorsmaster.typeid` for customer type, `custbranch.area` or
   `salesanalysis.area`, the salesperson) and, if columns are added to an
   existing table, every writer of that table fills them.
6. The 12 methods as specified, with minimum history enforced, no negative
   quantities, and best fit by hold-out accuracy (single item and
   category).
7. Review and revision: revised quantity overrides calculated quantity in
   review, accuracy and MRP; clearing it restores the calculated one.
8. Accuracy metrics MAD, POA, MSE, RMSE against actuals; method comparison.
9. MRP integration: writes `mrpdemands` (stockid, mrpdemandtype, quantity,
   duedate) under a forecast demand type that the upgrade creates in
   `mrpdemandtypes`; replace and incremental modes never double demand and
   never touch other demand types; MRP.php then plans from them.
10. Parameters stored and editable (alpha, beta, gamma, season length, MA
    periods, hold-out, horizon) and used as defaults.
11. Category and batch generation with per-item results and failure
    reasons; dashboard and inquiry.
12. Nothing existing breaks: menus of other modules, existing pages, fresh
    install (positional INSERTs match their tables).

1489	new file mode 100644
1490	index 0000000..be2ceaf
1491	--- /dev/null
1492	+++ b/NOTES.md
1493	@@ -0,0 +1,108 @@
1494	+# Demand forecasting – implementation notes
1495	+
1496	+Nothing here has been run: there was no PHP/MySQL to run against, so the change is delivered as files and has
1497	+been checked by reading only. Run the upgrade on a copy of a database and click through the pages before release.
1498	+
1499	+## What was built
1500	+
1501	+A **Forecasting** main-menu module (`forecast`, report link `fcst`) placed right after Manufacturing, ten pages and
1502	+one shared library.
1503	+
1504	+| Page | Security token | Purpose |
1505	+|---|---|---|
1506	+| `ForecastDashboard.php` | 2 | counts of active forecasts / summaries, history range, MRP demands from forecasts, links |
1507	+| `ForecastHistory.php` | 11 | extract the monthly sales history (range, replace on re-run, shows range/items/months) |
1508	+| `ForecastGenerate.php` | 11 | item or whole category, location or all combined, horizon, 12 methods or best fit, batch with progress and result list |
1509	+| `ForecastReview.php` | 11 | search by item/category/location; calculated, revised (editable), forecast used, last year's actual, variance (highlighted) |
1510	+| `ForecastSummary.php` | 11 | summary forecasts by category / customer type / sales area / salesperson, review screen with the items behind each summary |
1511	+| `ForecastToMRP.php` | 11 | convert active forecasts to MRP demands (replace / incremental) |
1512	+| `ForecastInquiry.php` | 2 | forecasts by item, category, location and period |
1513	+| `ForecastAccuracy.php` | 2 | MAD, POA, MSE, RMSE per item, category and method; low-accuracy flag |
1514	+| `ForecastMethodCompare.php` | 2 | one item, all methods side by side on held-out months |
1515	+| `ForecastParameters.php` | 15 | company-wide defaults (admin only) |
1516	+| `includes/ForecastFunctions.php` | – | extraction, the 12 methods, best fit, accuracy, storing, batches, MRP conversion |
1517	+
1518	+The Forecasting menu also links the existing Master Schedule (`MRPDemands.php`), MRP Calculation (`MRP.php`) and
1519	+MRP report (`MRPReport.php`).
1520	+
1521	+### Tables (new)
1522	+`forecastparameters` (key/value defaults plus history-range state), `forecasthistory`, `forecasts` +
1523	+`forecastdetails`, `forecastsummaries` + `forecastsummarydetails`, `forecastbatches` + `forecastbatchresults`,
1524	+`forecastmrpdemands`. Definitions are identical in `install/sql/tables/*.sql` (new installs) and
1525	+`sql/updates/44.php` (existing databases).
1526	+
1527	+## How it ships
1528	+- **Existing databases:** `sql/updates/44.php` (picked up automatically by the DB-version check): creates the tables,
1529	+  widens `www_users.modulesallowed` to 50, adds the module, 10 scripts (page security), 13 menu entries per role,
1530	+  demand type `FCST`, default parameters.
1531	+- **New installs:** `install/sql/tables/*`, `install/sql/data/{modules,menuitems,scripts}.sql` (edited),
1532	+  `forecastparameters.sql` and `mrpdemandtypes.sql` (new), and `install/sql/demo.sql` (appended statements, since demo mode
1533	+  loads only that file). `DBUpdateNumber` becomes 44 automatically (highest file in `sql/updates`).
1534	+- **User access:** `WWW_Users.php` has the new "Display Forecasting module" switch. `SuppLoginSetup.php` and
1535	+  `CustLoginSetup.php` were adjusted for the extra position.
1536	+- **Translations:** every string is wrapped in `__()`, including the menu captions in `44.php` (that is how
1537	+  captions reach the catalogue, as with `5.php`). I did not hand-edit the generated `messages.pot`; regenerate it with
1538	+  the usual gettext extraction / `Z_poRebuildDefault.php`.
1539	+
1540	+### Module flags are positional – the upgrade shifts them
1541	+`www_users.modulesallowed` is a comma list of 0/1 flags **in module sequence order** (`index.php` reads
1542	+`ModulesEnabled[$i]` against the `modules` rows ordered by `sequence`). Inserting Forecasting at position 7 therefore
1543	+moves every later module. `44.php` inserts a `0` into each existing user's list at the position the new module takes
1544	+for that user's role (count of the role's modules with sequence < 7, computed before the module is added), so each
1545	+user keeps exactly the modules they had, Forecasting is off, and GL/FA/PC/Setup/Utilities flags stay attached to the
1546	+right modules. It runs once (marker row `UserFlagsAdded` in `forecastparameters`), so a retried upgrade does not shift
1547	+twice. The administrator enables Forecasting per user in User Maintenance. New installs give the admin all 12 flags.
1548	+The column had to be widened (13 flags would exceed `varchar(25)`).
1549	+
1550	+## Sales history – where the forecast gets its data
1551	+`forecasthistory` is filled by `ForecastExtractHistory()` from `stockmoves` with
1552	+`type IN (10, 11) AND hidemovt = 0` (invoices less credit notes, quantity = `-qty`) – the same movements
1553	+`InventoryPlanning.php` uses, not open orders. It is grouped by item, stock location, customer type
1554	+(`debtorsmaster.typeid`), sales area and salesperson (`custbranch`), and calendar month, so summary forecasts come from the
1555	+same rows. Re-running a range deletes and rewrites that range. The range held is kept in `forecastparameters`
1556	+(`HistoryFrom`/`HistoryTo`).
1557	+
1558	+## How a forecast reaches MRP
1559	+`ForecastToMRP.php` → `ForecastConvertToMRP()`:
1560	+1. take the **active** forecast of each item, quantity = `COALESCE(revisedqty, calcqty)`;
1561	+2. write one `mrpdemands` row per month (due the 1st) under demand type **`FCST` "Statistical Forecast"** (seeded by the
1562	+   upgrade/installer);
1563	+3. record every row it writes in `forecastmrpdemands`.
1564	+
1565	+*Replace* deletes only demands listed in `forecastmrpdemands` for the same items and months, then writes; *incremental*
1566	+skips months already listed. Both are idempotent, so converting twice never doubles demand, and hand-entered demands
1567	+(even if someone typed them under `FCST`) or demands from MRPCreateDemands are never touched. Tracking rows whose
1568	+demand was deleted in the Master Schedule are cleaned up on the next conversion. The existing MRP run then plans
1569	+from `mrpdemands` as usual.
1570	+
1571	+## Interpretations of ambiguous BRD points
1572	+- **Item vs location forecasts.** One active forecast per item *and* location (blank location = all combined), enforced by
1573	+  a unique key on `(stockid, loccode, active)` where superseded rows have `active = NULL`. For MRP, an item's all-locations
1574	+  forecast is used if there is one, otherwise its active location forecasts are added – never both.
1575	+- **Regenerating** supersedes the old forecast (kept, with method/parameters) and does not carry revisions over.
1576	+- **"History" length** is counted from the item's first month with sales to the end of the extracted range (zero months in
1577	+  between are zeros). Months before the first sale are not history, so a new item is "reported", not padded. Net-negative
1578	+  months count as zero demand. The minimum months per method are as in the BRD; where a method has a parameter that needs
1579	+  more (moving-average N, weight count, 2 × season length) the larger number applies. A failed item gets a reason.
1580	+- **Whole months only**; the month in progress is never extracted (a part month looks like a collapse in demand). A range not
1581	+  touching the range already held replaces it so there are no gaps that look like zero sales.
1582	+- **Method details chosen where the BRD is silent:** 2 = (last 12 months ÷ the 12 before) applied to last year's same month;
1583	+  5 = line through the last point and the point *k* months earlier (default 5, so min 6); 8 = user weights per prior
1584	+  period (lag 1..12, used as typed, rolled forward on its own results); 9 = weights scaled to sum to 1; 12 = additive
1585	+  seasonality, season length default 12; alpha limited to 0.1–0.9; forecasts are rounded and floored at 0.
1586	+- **Best fit:** hold out *n* months (default 3); for an item, lowest total absolute error wins (ties → lower method number);
1587	+  for a category, lowest total absolute error ÷ total actual sales across all its items, among methods applicable to at
1588	+  least half of the evaluable items. Items the chosen method cannot forecast are reported as failed. Summary forecasts pick
1589	+  per summary.
1590	+- **POA** = 100 × (1 − Σ|error| ÷ Σactual), floored at 0 (100 only if nothing sold and nothing forecast); MAD/MSE/RMSE are

1592	+  item and category figures (all forecasts for the per-method table). Low accuracy = POA below `LowAccuracyPOA` (70).

@@ -0,0 +1,108 @@
+# Demand forecasting – implementation notes
+
+Nothing here has been run: there was no PHP/MySQL to run against, so the change is delivered as files and has
+been checked by reading only. Run the upgrade on a copy of a database and click through the pages before release.
+
+## What was built
+
+A **Forecasting** main-menu module (`forecast`, report link `fcst`) placed right after Manufacturing, ten pages and
+one shared library.
+
+| Page | Security token | Purpose |
+|---|---|---|
+| `ForecastDashboard.php` | 2 | counts of active forecasts / summaries, history range, MRP demands from forecasts, links |
+| `ForecastHistory.php` | 11 | extract the monthly sales history (range, replace on re-run, shows range/items/months) |
+| `ForecastGenerate.php` | 11 | item or whole category, location or all combined, horizon, 12 methods or best fit, batch with progress and result list |
+| `ForecastReview.php` | 11 | search by item/category/location; calculated, revised (editable), forecast used, last year's actual, variance (highlighted) |
+| `ForecastSummary.php` | 11 | summary forecasts by category / customer type / sales area / salesperson, review screen with the items behind each summary |
+| `ForecastToMRP.php` | 11 | convert active forecasts to MRP demands (replace / incremental) |
+| `ForecastInquiry.php` | 2 | forecasts by item, category, location and period |
+| `ForecastAccuracy.php` | 2 | MAD, POA, MSE, RMSE per item, category and method; low-accuracy flag |
+| `ForecastMethodCompare.php` | 2 | one item, all methods side by side on held-out months |
+| `ForecastParameters.php` | 15 | company-wide defaults (admin only) |
+| `includes/ForecastFunctions.php` | – | extraction, the 12 methods, best fit, accuracy, storing, batches, MRP conversion |
+
+The Forecasting menu also links the existing Master Schedule (`MRPDemands.php`), MRP Calculation (`MRP.php`) and
+MRP report (`MRPReport.php`).
+
+### Tables (new)
+`forecastparameters` (key/value defaults plus history-range state), `forecasthistory`, `forecasts` +
+`forecastdetails`, `forecastsummaries` + `forecastsummarydetails`, `forecastbatches` + `forecastbatchresults`,
+`forecastmrpdemands`. Definitions are identical in `install/sql/tables/*.sql` (new installs) and
+`sql/updates/44.php` (existing databases).
+
+## How it ships
+- **Existing databases:** `sql/updates/44.php` (picked up automatically by the DB-version check): creates the tables,
+  widens `www_users.modulesallowed` to 50, adds the module, 10 scripts (page security), 13 menu entries per role,
+  demand type `FCST`, default parameters.
+- **New installs:** `install/sql/tables/*`, `install/sql/data/{modules,menuitems,scripts}.sql` (edited),
+  `forecastparameters.sql` and `mrpdemandtypes.sql` (new), and `install/sql/demo.sql` (appended statements, since demo mode
+  loads only that file). `DBUpdateNumber` becomes 44 automatically (highest file in `sql/updates`).
+- **User access:** `WWW_Users.php` has the new "Display Forecasting module" switch. `SuppLoginSetup.php` and
+  `CustLoginSetup.php` were adjusted for the extra position.
+- **Translations:** every string is wrapped in `__()`, including the menu captions in `44.php` (that is how
+  captions reach the catalogue, as with `5.php`). I did not hand-edit the generated `messages.pot`; regenerate it with
+  the usual gettext extraction / `Z_poRebuildDefault.php`.
+
+### Module flags are positional – the upgrade shifts them
+`www_users.modulesallowed` is a comma list of 0/1 flags **in module sequence order** (`index.php` reads
+`ModulesEnabled[$i]` against the `modules` rows ordered by `sequence`). Inserting Forecasting at position 7 therefore
+moves every later module. `44.php` inserts a `0` into each existing user's list at the position the new module takes
+for that user's role (count of the role's modules with sequence < 7, computed before the module is added), so each
+user keeps exactly the modules they had, Forecasting is off, and GL/FA/PC/Setup/Utilities flags stay attached to the
+right modules. It runs once (marker row `UserFlagsAdded` in `forecastparameters`), so a retried upgrade does not shift
+twice. The administrator enables Forecasting per user in User Maintenance. New installs give the admin all 12 flags.
+The column had to be widened (13 flags would exceed `varchar(25)`).
+
+## Sales history – where the forecast gets its data
+`forecasthistory` is filled by `ForecastExtractHistory()` from `stockmoves` with
+`type IN (10, 11) AND hidemovt = 0` (invoices less credit notes, quantity = `-qty`) – the same movements
+`InventoryPlanning.php` uses, not open orders. It is grouped by item, stock location, customer type
+(`debtorsmaster.typeid`), sales area and salesperson (`custbranch`), and calendar month, so summary forecasts come from the
+same rows. Re-running a range deletes and rewrites that range. The range held is kept in `forecastparameters`
+(`HistoryFrom`/`HistoryTo`).
+
+## How a forecast reaches MRP
+`ForecastToMRP.php` → `ForecastConvertToMRP()`:
+1. take the **active** forecast of each item, quantity = `COALESCE(revisedqty, calcqty)`;
+2. write one `mrpdemands` row per month (due the 1st) under demand type **`FCST` "Statistical Forecast"** (seeded by the
+   upgrade/installer);
+3. record every row it writes in `forecastmrpdemands`.
+
+*Replace* deletes only demands listed in `forecastmrpdemands` for the same items and months, then writes; *incremental*
+skips months already listed. Both are idempotent, so converting twice never doubles demand, and hand-entered demands
+(even if someone typed them under `FCST`) or demands from MRPCreateDemands are never touched. Tracking rows whose
+demand was deleted in the Master Schedule are cleaned up on the next conversion. The existing MRP run then plans
+from `mrpdemands` as usual.
+
+## Interpretations of ambiguous BRD points
+- **Item vs location forecasts.** One active forecast per item *and* location (blank location = all combined), enforced by
+  a unique key on `(stockid, loccode, active)` where superseded rows have `active = NULL`. For MRP, an item's all-locations
+  forecast is used if there is one, otherwise its active location forecasts are added – never both.
+- **Regenerating** supersedes the old forecast (kept, with method/parameters) and does not carry revisions over.
+- **"History" length** is counted from the item's first month with sales to the end of the extracted range (zero months in
+  between are zeros). Months before the first sale are not history, so a new item is "reported", not padded. Net-negative
+  months count as zero demand. The minimum months per method are as in the BRD; where a method has a parameter that needs
+  more (moving-average N, weight count, 2 × season length) the larger number applies. A failed item gets a reason.
+- **Whole months only**; the month in progress is never extracted (a part month looks like a collapse in demand). A range not
+  touching the range already held replaces it so there are no gaps that look like zero sales.
+- **Method details chosen where the BRD is silent:** 2 = (last 12 months ÷ the 12 before) applied to last year's same month;
+  5 = line through the last point and the point *k* months earlier (default 5, so min 6); 8 = user weights per prior
+  period (lag 1..12, used as typed, rolled forward on its own results); 9 = weights scaled to sum to 1; 12 = additive
+  seasonality, season length default 12; alpha limited to 0.1–0.9; forecasts are rounded and floored at 0.
+- **Best fit:** hold out *n* months (default 3); for an item, lowest total absolute error wins (ties → lower method number);
+  for a category, lowest total absolute error ÷ total actual sales across all its items, among methods applicable to at
+  least half of the evaluable items. Items the chosen method cannot forecast are reported as failed. Summary forecasts pick
+  per summary.
+- **POA** = 100 × (1 − Σ|error| ÷ Σactual), floored at 0 (100 only if nothing sold and nothing forecast); MAD/MSE/RMSE are
+  per period. Accuracy uses only completed months, revised quantities, and the latest forecast per item/location/month for
+  item and category figures (all forecasts for the per-method table). Low accuracy = POA below `LowAccuracyPOA` (70).
+- **Page security:** reports/inquiry/dashboard/method comparison = 2; history, generate, review, summary, convert = 11
+  (inventory management); parameters = 15 because the BRD says an administrator edits them. Every role gets the menu rows
+  (as for all other modules); the menu hides what the user's tokens do not allow.
+- **No foreign keys to `stockmaster`:** `stockmaster.stockid` is `varchar(20)` in the installer table files but `varchar(64)`
+  after update 43, and a mismatch would block the constraint on one of the two paths. The new tables use `varchar(64)`.
+- **Sales history is company-wide** (not limited to the extracting user's locations); pages are not location-restricted.
+- Batch generation processes 25 items per request and continues itself via an auto-submitting form (progress bar, button as
+  fallback); a category's best-fit method is decided up front from one query.
+- Out of scope as per BRD: email/cron, promotions, value forecasts, what-if.

+<?php
+
+// DEMAND FORECASTING MODULE
+//
+// 1. www_users.modulesallowed holds one flag per module, in module sequence order: room for one more flag
+// 2. new tables: sales history, forecasts, summary forecasts, batch runs, MRP demands created from forecasts
+// 3. new module "Forecasting" (after Manufacturing), its pages, menu entries, MRP demand type and default parameters
+// 4. existing users get a 0 flag in the position of the new module, so they keep exactly the modules they had and
+//    every later module keeps its flag; administrators then grant Forecasting in User Maintenance
+
+ChangeColumnSize('modulesallowed', 'www_users', 'VARCHAR(50)', ' NOT NULL ', '', '50');
+
+CreateTable('forecastparameters', "CREATE TABLE `forecastparameters` (
+  `paramname` varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  `paramvalue` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  PRIMARY KEY (`paramname`)
+)");
+
+CreateTable('forecasthistory', "CREATE TABLE `forecasthistory` (
+  `stockid` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  `loccode` varchar(5) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  `debtortype` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
+  `area` char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  `salesperson` varchar(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  `periodstart` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
+  `quantity` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
+  PRIMARY KEY (`stockid`,`loccode`,`debtortype`,`area`,`salesperson`,`periodstart`),
+  KEY `periodstart` (`periodstart`),
+  KEY `loccode` (`loccode`),
+  KEY `debtortype` (`debtortype`),
+  KEY `area` (`area`),
+  KEY `salesperson` (`salesperson`)
+)");
+
+CreateTable('forecasts', "CREATE TABLE `forecasts` (
+  `forecastid` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
+  `stockid` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  `loccode` varchar(5) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  `methodid` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
+  `parameters` text,
+  `horizon` smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
+  `historyfrom` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
+  `historyto` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
+  `historymonths` smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
+  `generatedon` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01 00:00:00',
+  `generatedby` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  `active` tinyint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '1 = the forecast MRP uses, NULL = superseded',
+  `supersededon` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
+  PRIMARY KEY (`forecastid`),
+  UNIQUE KEY `oneactive` (`stockid`,`loccode`,`active`),
+  KEY `stockid` (`stockid`),
+  KEY `generatedon` (`generatedon`)
+)");
+
+CreateTable('forecastdetails', "CREATE TABLE `forecastdetails` (
+  `forecastid` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
+  `periodstart` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
+  `calcqty` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
+  `revisedqty` double DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'planner override, NULL = use calcqty',
+  PRIMARY KEY (`forecastid`,`periodstart`),
+  KEY `periodstart` (`periodstart`),
+  CONSTRAINT `forecastdetails_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`forecastid`) REFERENCES `forecasts` (`forecastid`) ON DELETE CASCADE
+)");
+
+CreateTable('forecastsummaries', "CREATE TABLE `forecastsummaries` (
+  `summaryid` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
+  `dimension` varchar(12) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT 'category, debtortype, area or salesperson',
+  `dimkey` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  `methodid` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
+  `parameters` text,
+  `horizon` smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
+  `historyfrom` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
+  `historyto` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
+  `historymonths` smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
+  `generatedon` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01 00:00:00',
+  `generatedby` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  `active` tinyint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '1 = current summary, NULL = superseded',
+  `supersededon` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
+  PRIMARY KEY (`summaryid`),
+  UNIQUE KEY `oneactive` (`dimension`,`dimkey`,`active`)
+)");
+
+CreateTable('forecastsummarydetails', "CREATE TABLE `forecastsummarydetails` (
+  `summaryid` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
+  `periodstart` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
+  `calcqty` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
+  `revisedqty` double DEFAULT NULL,
+  PRIMARY KEY (`summaryid`,`periodstart`),
+  CONSTRAINT `forecastsummarydetails_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`summaryid`) REFERENCES `forecastsummaries` (`summaryid`) ON DELETE CASCADE
+)");
+
+CreateTable('forecastbatches', "CREATE TABLE `forecastbatches` (
+  `batchid` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
+  `userid` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  `createdon` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01 00:00:00',
+  `scope` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'item' COMMENT 'item or category',
+  `stockid` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  `categoryid` varchar(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  `loccode` varchar(5) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  `methodid` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '0 = best fit',
+  `chosenmethod` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
+  `parameters` text,
+  `horizon` smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
+  `status` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running',
+  `total` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
+  `success` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
+  `failed` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
+  PRIMARY KEY (`batchid`)
+)");
+
+CreateTable('forecastbatchresults', "CREATE TABLE `forecastbatchresults` (
+  `batchid` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
+  `stockid` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  `status` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
+  `methodid` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
+  `forecastid` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
+  `message` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  PRIMARY KEY (`batchid`,`stockid`),
+  KEY `status` (`batchid`,`status`),
+  CONSTRAINT `forecastbatchresults_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`batchid`) REFERENCES `forecastbatches` (`batchid`) ON DELETE CASCADE
+)");
+
+CreateTable('forecastmrpdemands', "CREATE TABLE `forecastmrpdemands` (
+  `demandid` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT 'mrpdemands row created from a forecast',
+  `stockid` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  `periodstart` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
+  PRIMARY KEY (`demandid`),
+  KEY `stockperiod` (`stockid`,`periodstart`)
+)");
+
+// Default parameters
+$ForecastDefaults = array('Alpha' => '0.3',
+						'Beta' => '0.1',
+						'DefaultHistoryMonths' => '24',
+						'DefaultHorizon' => '12',
+						'FlexibleWeights' => '0.25,0.2,0.15,0.1,0.05,0.05,0.05,0.05,0.025,0.025,0.025,0.025',
+						'Gamma' => '0.1',
+						'GrowthPercent' => '10',
+						'HoldoutMonths' => '3',
+						'LinearBackPeriods' => '5',
+						'LowAccuracyPOA' => '70',
+						'MAPeriods' => '4',
+						'SeasonLength' => '12',
+						'VarianceHighlightPct' => '25',
+						'WMAWeights' => '0.4,0.3,0.2,0.1');
+foreach ($ForecastDefaults as $ParamName => $ParamValue) {
+	InsertRecord('forecastparameters', array('paramname'), array($ParamName), array('paramname', 'paramvalue'), array($ParamName, $ParamValue));
+}
+
+// Existing users: add the flag for the new module. Done once only (marker row), and before the module exists,
+// because the position of the new module is the number of modules of the user's role ahead of it.
+$Result = DB_query("SELECT paramvalue FROM forecastparameters WHERE paramname = 'UserFlagsAdded'");
+if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
+	$ModulesAhead = array();
+	$Users = DB_query("SELECT userid, fullaccess, modulesallowed FROM www_users");
+	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Users)) {
+		if (!isset($ModulesAhead[$MyRow['fullaccess']])) {
+			$CountResult = DB_query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM modules WHERE secroleid = '" . $MyRow['fullaccess'] . "' AND sequence < 7");
+			$CountRow = DB_fetch_row($CountResult);
+			$ModulesAhead[$MyRow['fullaccess']] = (int) $CountRow[0];
+		}
+		$Position = $ModulesAhead[$MyRow['fullaccess']];
+		$Trailing = (substr($MyRow['modulesallowed'], -1) == ',');
+		$Flags = explode(',', rtrim($MyRow['modulesallowed'], ','));
+		while (count($Flags) < $Position) {
+			$Flags[] = '0';
+		}
+		array_splice($Flags, $Position, 0, array('0'));
+		$Response = executeSQL("UPDATE www_users SET modulesallowed = '" . DB_escape_string(implode(',', $Flags) . ($Trailing ? ',' : '')) . "'
+								WHERE userid = '" . DB_escape_string($MyRow['userid']) . "'", false);
+		if ($Response != 0) {
+			OutputResult(__('The modules of user') . ' ' . $MyRow['userid'] . ' ' . __('could not be updated'), 'error');
+		}
+	}
+	if ($_SESSION['Updates']['Errors'] == 0) {
+		InsertRecord('forecastparameters', array('paramname'), array('UserFlagsAdded'), array('paramname', 'paramvalue'), array('UserFlagsAdded', '1'));
+	}
+}
+
+NewModule('forecast', 'fcst', __('Forecasting'), 7);
+
+// Pages and their page security (11 inventory management, 2 reports and inquiries, 15 administration)
+NewScript('ForecastAccuracy.php', 2);
+NewScript('ForecastDashboard.php', 2);
+NewScript('ForecastGenerate.php', 11);
+NewScript('ForecastHistory.php', 11);
+NewScript('ForecastInquiry.php', 2);
+NewScript('ForecastMethodCompare.php', 2);
+NewScript('ForecastParameters.php', 15);
+NewScript('ForecastReview.php', 11);
+NewScript('ForecastSummary.php', 11);
+NewScript('ForecastToMRP.php', 11);
+
+NewMenuItem('forecast', 'Transactions', __('Extract Sales History'), '/ForecastHistory.php', 1);
+NewMenuItem('forecast', 'Transactions', __('Generate Forecasts'), '/ForecastGenerate.php', 2);
+NewMenuItem('forecast', 'Transactions', __('Review and Revise Forecasts'), '/ForecastReview.php', 3);
+NewMenuItem('forecast', 'Transactions', __('Summary Forecasts'), '/ForecastSummary.php', 4);
+NewMenuItem('forecast', 'Transactions', __('Convert Forecasts to MRP Demands'), '/ForecastToMRP.php', 5);
+NewMenuItem('forecast', 'Reports', __('Forecasting Dashboard'), '/ForecastDashboard.php', 1);
+NewMenuItem('forecast', 'Reports', __('Forecast Inquiry'), '/ForecastInquiry.php', 2);
+NewMenuItem('forecast', 'Reports', __('Forecast Accuracy'), '/ForecastAccuracy.php', 3);
+NewMenuItem('forecast', 'Reports', __('Forecast Method Comparison'), '/ForecastMethodCompare.php', 4);
+NewMenuItem('forecast', 'Reports', __('MRP'), '/MRPReport.php', 5);
+NewMenuItem('forecast', 'Maintenance', __('Forecasting Parameters'), '/ForecastParameters.php', 1);
+NewMenuItem('forecast', 'Maintenance', __('Master Schedule'), '/MRPDemands.php', 2);
+NewMenuItem('forecast', 'Maintenance', __('MRP Calculation'), '/MRP.php', 3);
+
+// The demand type the forecasts are converted under
+InsertRecord('mrpdemandtypes', array('mrpdemandtype'), array('FCST'), array('mrpdemandtype', 'description'), array('FCST', __('Statistical Forecast')));
+
+if ($_SESSION['Updates']['Errors'] == 0) {
+	UpdateDBNo(basename(__FILE__, '.php'), __('Demand forecasting module'));
+}
